what: When the list comes within 80px of the screen bottom, the cells rise from 100px below at .08s intervals over 1s and settle with a slight overshoot (transparency clears in .15s). When scrolled back up, they drop down and hide again so they rise next time

options.y: Distance below before rising (px), default 100 (the original report card uses 120)
options.offset: How far it must enter from the bottom of the screen (px), default 80
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Rising cells (children) — if none, all direct children of the element

from.where: index.css .js-view .mk-sus__item (y 100) · .mk-card (y 120) — original js-view-elm is-view-show, .23+.08i s per cell
